data.one_liner: Provides automatic retry with exponential back‑off for async functions.
data.what_it_does: Wraps a Future‑returning function and retries it on specified errors. Allows configuration of max attempts and back‑off intervals via RetryOptions.
use_when: You need resilient network calls that may fail intermittently
You want simple exponential back‑off without adding custom logic
avoid_when: You require sophisticated retry policies like jitter algorithms beyond the built‑in +/-25%
You need retry support for streams or reactive pipelines
strengths: Zero external dependencies","Built‑in exponential back‑off with configurable attempts","Works on all Dart platforms
weaknesses: Limited to simple Future‑based retries","No built‑in jitter customization beyond the fixed variance"]
